sources.title: QuerynAi/queryn-adapter-ada-002_to_qwen3-emb-8b · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Queryn adapter — ada-002 → qwen3-emb-8b Translates an embedding produced by ada-002 into the embedding space of qwen3-emb-8b, so a corpus already embedded with ada-002 can be served against a qwen3-emb-8b index without re-embedding it. Part of the Queryn embedding-translation engine.

sources.title: Qwen3 Technical Report - arXiv.org
sources.snippet: Abstract In this work, we present Qwen3, the latest version of the Qwen model family. Qwen3 comprises a series of large language models (LLMs) designed to advance performance, efficiency, and multilingual capabilities.
